gloss: to carry in; to bring in; to haul into

definitions.gloss: to carry in; to bring in; to haul into a place
definitions.explanation: To move something bulky or heavy into a building or enclosed space. The compound stresses the endpoint of the movement: the object ends up inside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{運|はこ}び{込|こ}んだ。
⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{運|はこ}び{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: The injured person was rushed into the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{朝早|あさはや}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{機材|きざい}→機材：13187_kizai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{運|はこ}び{込|こ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The contractors had been hauling equipment into the venue since early morning.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧ (to carry) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). Transitive: the thing carried takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ and the destination takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

ASPECT (ている):
{運|はこ}び{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ can mean either an action in progress (is carrying things in) or a resulting state (has brought them in and they are there); context decides.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{運|はこ}び{込|こ}まれる: to be rushed to hospital
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{運|はこ}び{込|こ}む: to carry luggage into a room
- ⟦{機材|きざい}→機材：13187_kizai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{運|はこ}び{込|こ}む: to haul in equipment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}む→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧: to bring in — smaller items carried by hand, often where permission is at issue
- ⟦{搬入|はんにゅう}→搬入：16523_hannyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deliver in — formal, used of freight and exhibition setup
